notes.title: Major Update and Launch Event November 1st
notes.content:
We upgraded our application with our first major update including an updated design, bug fixes and a few new features for settings. We are also announcing our Publisher Launch Event which will include sales for all of our applications, live events, community activities and more. Be sure to join us for the event starting [u][b]November 1st[/b][/u]!
